column1: # Source-owned JWT compact-token/retry/load tests for server-auth-token-boundary-wave.

column8: Covers invalid compact-token segment counts, empty-segment preservation, initial-attempt plus retry ordering, reload-after-verification-failure, no-reload payload rejection, missing-JWKS/load-error preservation, and zero-retry exhaustion; RSA/JWK signing, filesystem/network refresh, JSON claims, and authenticated-session assertions remain external.
The original claim-subject/email/iat/exp/issuer checks remain an explicit external JWT/privilege boundary; this wave does not decode claims, verify signatures, or publish authenticated identity.
